title: Segment Tree: Range Minimum Query
statement:
Given an array of N integers, answer Q range minimum queries.

For each query (L, R), print the minimum value in A[L..R] (1-indexed, inclusive).

Build a Segment Tree for O(log N) per query.
inputFormat:
The first line contains N and Q.
The second line contains N integers.
The next Q lines each contain L and R.
outputFormat: Q lines, each the minimum of A[L..R].

starterCode.python:
n, q = map(int, input().split())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
queries = [tuple(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(q)]
